_our_local_dispatch_result_before_fix.note: BEFORE FIX: this real call exposed a genuine calibration gap. 'I'll be there in 10 minutes' matched no FIRM_MARKERS regex in mobilize/core/commitment.py (only words like 'leaving', 'on my way', 'right now', 'absolutely' were recognized), so it fell through to the neutral 0.5 default, landing just under the 0.55 confirmation threshold -- despite CALL-E's own extraction confidently saying final_position=confirmed, completion_confidence 0.95. The simulator never caught this because its synthetic phrases were generated from this exact marker list.

_our_local_dispatch_result_after_fix.note: AFTER FIX (commit pending): added \bin \d+ minutes?\b / \bin \d+ mins?\b as firm markers in mobilize/core/commitment.py, reasoning a concrete numeric ETA is itself a firm commitment signal distinct from vague hedges. Re-ran this exact call payload through mobilize.transports.calle._to_call_result after the fix: now scores 0.627, above threshold, matching CALL-E's own 'confirmed' verdict. Full test suite (310 passed/3 xfailed/2 xpassed) unaffected; harness re-run for drift check separately.
